name: ExpandTree
label: Expand Tree
description: Expands a tree node using a specified path (e.g., 'Menu → Submenu → Item').

fields.name: TreePath
fields.label: Tree Path
fields.description: The full path to the tree node to expand (e.g., 'Menu → Submenu → Item').

fields.name: DelayBefore
fields.label: Delay Before
fields.description: Delay before executing the action (in seconds). Default is 0.2 seconds.

fields.name: DelayAfter
fields.label: Delay After
fields.description: Delay after executing the action (in seconds). Default is 0.3 seconds.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: Maximum time to wait for the operation to complete (in seconds). Default is 30 seconds.

fields.name: AlterDisabledElement
fields.label: Alter disabled element
fields.description: Whether to allow interaction with disabled elements.

fields.name: HealingAgentMode
fields.label: Healing Agent mode
fields.description: Controls how the Healing Agent behaves during this activity.

selectOptions.label: Same as App/Browser
selectOptions.description: Uses the Healing Agent setting from the parent application or browser.

selectOptions.label: Inherit job settings
selectOptions.description: Uses job-level settings from Orchestrator or project settings.

selectOptions.label: Recommendation only
selectOptions.description: Allows Healing Agent to recommend fixes, but does not apply them.

selectOptions.label: Disabled
selectOptions.description: Healing Agent is completely disabled for this activity.

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on error
fields.description: Whether to continue execution if this activity fails.

fields.name: InputElement
fields.label: Input element
fields.description: The UI element representing the tree or container (e.g., a treeview control).
